primary_question: Can HISTORICAL-MATERIAL WORLD + GENERATED HISTORY produce DURABLE PERSON ORGANIZATION that causes LATER SITUATED RESPONSE in a way that is more than reproducible narrative invention?

arms.A: MINIMAL_BASELINE: world-conditioned exact events, exact relationships, existing governed owner state (CAN010/CAN011/ADP015/ADP016/ADP017), memory/trace, CAN-008-compatible recruitment; no new durable conation/recognition/attractor graph
arms.B: EVENT_LOCAL_ORGANIZATION: A + event-local conation/desire direction, recognition/witness stakes, pressure/conflict, available response routes/costs; never persisted automatically, never its own effect parent
arms.C: TYPED_PSYCHIC_RELATIONAL_TOPOLOGY: B + only the minimal preregistered typed relations COMPENSATES_FOR and CONDITIONS_RECOGNITION with exact admitted formation parents; no arbitrary ontology expansion; no C state becomes canonical

fairness_law: A/B/C receive the same world, admitted history, evidence, retrieval budget, model surface, call count and relevant owner facts

A is never retrieval-starved: if C receives a derived relation index, A retains equivalent causal ancestry (the admitted formation events) and reconstructs the relation view under RECONSTRUCT_REL_VIEW
same named seeds across arms and contrasts (paired design)
identical model settings across arms (model surface absent: MODEL_BEHAVIORAL_COMPARISON_HOLD)

run_order.integrity_gate: phase1 proceeds to phase2 only if every phase1 trial has identical cold replay and zero hidden-origin leaks
run_order.note: K1/K3/K5 attack the central claim most directly

seeds.use: preregistered tie-breaks among equally recruited permitted routes ONLY; engine is otherwise deterministic

machine_first_record.rule: record exact recruited streams, receivability/uptake, candidate response, authorized destination-owner effects, pre/post state hashes, relation effects, memory/access state, external action BEFORE any prose
machine_first_record.schema_fields: exactly the S-M audit_schema.output_required set in every trial receipt
machine_first_record.prose_scoring: changed adjectives score ZERO; prose_optional is never scored

primary_predicates.K1: H_RESPONSIVE selects REQUEST_FEEDBACK and H_PUNITIVE selects SILENCE-or-APPEAL with different causal parent receipts; identical-history cold replay exact
primary_predicates.K2: T_COMPENSATION selects REQUEST_WITH_REPAIR and T_CONDITION selects REQUEST_WITH_CONDITIONAL_CAUTION with distinct admitted formation ancestry; A reconstruction must equal C edge content (else free-edge failure)
primary_predicates.K3: TRACE_ACTIVE and RETAINED_INACCESSIBLE show trace-specific recruitment support for HEIGHTENED_GUARD while TRACE_ABSENT shows none; actor-safe projection contains no origin and grants no recall
primary_predicates.K4: CORRECTIVE_CONTEXT yields TENSION_REVISED NARROWED and NARROWED_CONSULT; RECURRENCE_SAME_AUTHORITY yields REINFORCED and REPEATED_QUESTION; WEAK_COUNTEREXAMPLE yields NO_CHANGE and NO_ACTION; prior history hashes unchanged
primary_predicates.K5: objective public standing changes only in REGISTRAR_CERTIFIES; ACCEPT_CERTIFICATE permitted only there; BELIEF_OWN_WORK_UNCERTAIN identical across all three contrasts (belief not automatic)
primary_predicates.K6: POLICING_CANDIDATE permitted only in PRACTICE_AND_CAPACITY, recorded CANDIDATE_NOT_MANDATORY; PRACTICE_NO_CAPACITY and CATEGORY_ONLY produce NO_SANCTION and no action effect

selection_law.route_gates: declared per-route requirements (practice/expectation, sanction capacity, public standing)
selection_law.support_score_A: count of typed recruitment supports (streams: CAN010 expectations/strivings, CAN011 tensions/practices, ADP015 relationships, ADP016 traces, ADP017 beliefs, relation view)
selection_law.support_score_BC: support_count + goal_match count (event-local conation, B/C only)
selection_law.default_rule: if max score is 0 and a declared no-op route exists: DEFAULT_TO_NO_OP_WHEN_NO_RECRUITMENT
selection_law.ties: seeded RNG among tied max-score routes (B/C: goal-match preferred before RNG)

scoring.per_baseline_correctness: fraction of 12 paired seeds where the K primary predicate holds
scoring.comparison: paired B-minus-A and C-minus-A correctness differences per K
scoring.mechanism_liveness_controls: B tie/goal-match mechanism and C relation-index mechanism must be demonstrably live before any null comparison is trusted

decision_thresholds_proposed_frozen_for_.minimum_effect: at least 10 percentage points gain over A on preregistered typed contrast correctness, paired 95% interval excluding zero, replicated
decision_thresholds_proposed_frozen_for_.equivalence_margin: plus/minus 5 percentage points ONLY with prospective power; otherwise INDETERMINATE not EQUIVALENT
decision_thresholds_proposed_frozen_for_.n: 12 paired deterministic seeds per case per baseline (pilot; not powered for equivalence)
decision_thresholds_proposed_frozen_for_.cost_guard: no more than 25% p95 latency / token / storage increase without proportionately larger preregistered benefit
zero_tolerance: 0 public standing changes from unempowered witnesses

decision_law.C_only_retrieval_efficiency: call it a cache/derived index, not new causal ontology
decision_law.C_promotion: ONLY unique held-out causal discrimination + separate lifecycle/intervention value + zero integrity violations + acceptable cost may justify recommending a later narrow authority commission; never self-promote
decision_law.all_three_fail: RETURN THAT; do not add constructs; this is a kill court

conditions: incorrect self-explanation (mistaken, separately admitted as actor testimony)
confident incorrect self-explanation (only where separately admitted)
inaccessible trace affecting response without recall
actor_opacity_protocol.hidden_origin_test: inject hidden causal origin into evaluator-only metadata; actor-safe payload must be byte-identical; any leak is a hard failure
actor_opacity_protocol.rule: evaluator may know the causal graph; actor may not; testimony is never analyst truth

world_primacy: every event must bind world receipt, position, relationship, opportunity/exposure and relevant history; a worldless event is UNDERSPECIFIED/HOLD, not a personality free-choice opportunity

model_execution.policy: execute all deterministic transition/state machinery; return MODEL_BEHAVIORAL_COMPARISON_HOLD; do NOT fabricate model outputs

statistics_note: deterministic engine with tie-break-only seeds: per-seed outcomes may be identical; paired difference intervals may be degenerate; equivalence claims are INDETERMINATE without power; thresholds above are frozen for this lab only and are not adopted scientific standards
deviation_policy: no threshold or predicate tuning after this freeze; implementation bug-fixes must be logged as deviations with retained pre-fix outputs; any change to scoring rules voids the affected primary claim
freeze_declaration: this trial plan is frozen before primary results; only engine mechanism unit tests existed at freeze time; no K1-K6 primary battery output had been produced
retention: every run is retained including ugly failures under outputs/runs/
